question: How many terabytes make one petabyte?
solution:
The correct answer is **__1024.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **1 Petabyte = 1024 Terabytes.**
 
• The units of Computer Memory Measurements are:
 
 
• 1 Bit = Binary Digit.
 
• 8 Bits = 1 Byte.&l
